summary: Client-side rendered SaaS: every page's HTML is an empty root div plus a script bundle, so crawlers that do not run JavaScript see no content.

expected_facts.fact: The pages are client-side rendered: the served HTML has an empty <div id="root"> and a script; the visible headings and copy exist only inside /static/js/main.4f2a9c.js.
AI crawlers that do not execute JavaScript (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot) therefore receive no readable content, so citability and content quality cannot be credited from the HTML.
All four pages share the same title "Ledgerly" and the same meta description.
No page has an H1 in the served HTML and no page has any structured data.
The recommended fix is server-side rendering, static pre-rendering or dynamic rendering so the HTML carries the content.
There is no llms.txt (404). robots.txt allows all crawlers and the sitemap lists 4 URLs.
